name: Cable Woodchopper
common_faults: pulling with the arms rather than rotating through the trunk
not rotating through the hips — just the spine
contraindications: acute spinal disc injury aggravated by rotation under load
resistance_profile: constant cable tension through the rotational arc; hardest at the start when cable is most perpendicular to the movement

provenance.notes: Trains triplanar trunk rotation in a controlled, loaded manner. High-to-low and low-to-high variants target different oblique angles. SFR heuristic.
